pre_score_amendments.finding: a contraction rewrite such as "are not" to "aren't" costs two word-level edit operations (substitute plus delete), so even a semantically faithful, rules-only transformation of a short source reaches a word edit rate near 0.27; the original 0.15 gate would fail rows for reasons unrelated to the research question
pre_score_amendments.reason: word edit rate gate was set below the mechanical floor of the ruleset before any scoring
